entities.name: IDENTITY REQUEST message
entities.description: Message sent by the network to request identity information from the UE.

entities.name: IDENTITY RESPONSE message
entities.description: Message sent by the UE in response to an IDENTITY REQUEST, containing the requested identification parameters.

entities.name: Identity type IE
entities.description: Information element in IDENTITY REQUEST indicating the type of identity requested.

entities.name: SUCI
entities.description: Subscription Concealed Identifier, a protected form of subscription identifier.

entities.name: Timer T3519
entities.description: Timer used to manage SUCI freshness and prevent frequent regeneration.

entities.name: Identity type IE set to SUCI
entities.description: Condition where the Identity type IE in IDENTITY REQUEST is set to SUCI.

entities.name: Timer T3519 not running
entities.description: Condition where timer T3519 is not currently active.

entities.name: Timer T3519 running
entities.description: Condition where timer T3519 is currently active.

entities.name: Store SUCI value
entities.description: UE stores the value of the SUCI sent in IDENTITY RESPONSE for reuse while T3519 is running.

entities.name: Generate fresh SUCI
entities.description: UE generates a new SUCI as specified in 3GPP TS 33.501 when T3519 is not running.

relations.description: IDENTITY REQUEST message contains the Identity type IE.
IDENTITY RESPONSE message contains the SUCI when requested.
When SUCI is requested, behavior depends on whether T3519 is running or not.
If T3519 is not running, UE generates a fresh SUCI.
If T3519 is not running, UE starts timer T3519 after sending IDENTITY RESPONSE with fresh SUCI.
If T3519 is not running, UE stores the SUCI value sent in IDENTITY RESPONSE.
If T3519 is running, UE sends the stored SUCI in IDENTITY RESPONSE.
